name: Shibata Kanako
source:
One of the girls who used to play a lot when Ayumi was young.
She self-proclaimed her personality to be very "Whatever" and always makes jokes.
Compared to Everyone, she seems doesn't really want to get out of the Mansion that much.
She is the type who wants to have skinship with someone she wants to befriends with.

"Ayu, who once looked like a Girl, now has completely turned into a Boy~"

[From the [url=https://www.lumpofsugar.co.jp/product/yumahorome/#modal4]official website[/url]]
